label: AbiB system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiB-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder AbiB__AbiB profile and exemplified by the Lactococcus lactis IL1403 determinant whose AbiB activity blocks sensitive bIL170 phage growth and promotes rapid degradation of sensitive phage transcripts after infection.
observations: AbiB branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiB genes, AbiB proteins, bIL170 or bIL41 phage host-range outcomes, the DefenseFinder AbiB__AbiB HMM profile, source database rows naming one AbiB locus, sensitive phage transcript decay as a process, unresolved AbiB-triggered RNase mechanisms, and generic abortive infection systems.
